title: kactivitymanagerd fails to register with xdg-desktop-portal due to missing app metadata
line: The activity manager no longer logs a portal "App info not found" error at every login.
explanation: Qt registers every GUI application with the host portal using QGuiApplication::desktopFileName(). For kactivitymanagerd that name came from KAboutData's default, org.kde.ActivityManager, and no such desktop file exists, so xdg-desktop-portal answered "App info not found" and Qt logged a warning at each session start. The change installs a hidden org.kde.kactivitymanagerd.desktop (NoDisplay, like knighttimed's) and sets it as the desktop file name, so the registration succeeds.

commits.message:
service: install a desktop file for the portal app id

The app id taken from KAboutData was org.kde.ActivityManager, which has
no desktop file, so the portal refused to register it and a warning was
logged at every login. Install a hidden desktop file and point at it.

BUG: 516858

patches.diff:
From 7b22a45896e5505491e314cc805c8852f79d33aa Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 02:01:48 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] service: install a desktop file for the portal app id

The app id taken from KAboutData was org.kde.ActivityManager, which has
no desktop file, so the portal refused to register it and a warning was
logged at every login. Install a hidden desktop file and point at it.

BUG: 516858
---
 src/CMakeLists.txt                       | 4 ++++
 src/org.kde.kactivitymanagerd.desktop.in | 9 +++++++++
 src/service/Application.cpp              | 1 +
 3 files changed, 14 insertions(+)
 create mode 100644 src/org.kde.kactivitymanagerd.desktop.in

diff --git a/src/CMakeLists.txt b/src/CMakeLists.txt
index 2426c53b..0f6ffcf8 100644
--- a/src/CMakeLists.txt
+++ b/src/CMakeLists.txt
@@ -35,6 +35,10 @@ ecm_install_configured_files(
    INPUT plasma-kactivitymanagerd.service.in
    DESTINATION ${KDE_INSTALL_SYSTEMDUSERUNITDIR}
 )
+ecm_install_configured_files(
+   INPUT org.kde.kactivitymanagerd.desktop.in
+   DESTINATION ${KDE_INSTALL_APPDIR}
+)
 
 add_library(debug_STATIC STATIC)
 set_target_properties(debug_STATIC PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
diff --git a/src/org.kde.kactivitymanagerd.desktop.in b/src/org.kde.kactivitymanagerd.desktop.in
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..23243598
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/org.kde.kactivitymanagerd.desktop.in
@@ -0,0 +1,9 @@
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: None
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: CC0-1.0
+
+[Desktop Entry]
+Type=Application
+Name=Activity Manager
+Exec=@KDE_INSTALL_FULL_LIBEXECDIR@/kactivitymanagerd
+NoDisplay=true
+OnlyShowIn=KDE;
diff --git a/src/service/Application.cpp b/src/service/Application.cpp
index 63d959cc..01a7d419 100644
--- a/src/service/Application.cpp
+++ b/src/service/Application.cpp
@@ -250,6 +250,7 @@ int main(int argc, char **argv)
     Application application(argc, argv);
 
     KAboutData about(QStringLiteral("ActivityManager"), QString(), KACTIVITYMANAGERD_VERSION_STRING);
+    about.setDesktopFileName(QStringLiteral("org.kde.kactivitymanagerd"));
     KAboutData::setApplicationData(about);
 
     KCrash::initialize();
-- 
2.53.0

review.text: Fixes the cause: the app id derived from KAboutData had no matching desktop file, so the portal rejected registration. Installing a hidden NoDisplay desktop file and setting it via KAboutData::setDesktopFileName is the same pattern other Plasma daemons use, small and maintainable. No media is fine for a journal warning; the verify note quotes the before error and the successful registration after, and D-Bus activity calls still work.
